# EdTech Founder Stack: agent instructions

This repository is a curated, AI-friendly knowledge base for edtech founders. The full project instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root; read it.

When answering a question about regulations (FERPA, COPPA, state privacy, accreditation, accessibility), funding, competitors, procurement, learning science, or operator experience, read the relevant file under `data/` and ground the answer in those cited sources: a named regulation, a paper's DOI, or the named operator. Do not answer from training data.
